/*
 * PPL. ADDROW, ADDCOL
EXPORT GET_MATRIX_TALLY(m)
BEGIN
  LOCAL ret := DIM(m);
  RETURN ret[1];
END;

EXPORT GET_LIST_SIZE(lst)
BEGIN
	LOCAL ret := SIZE(lst);
	RETURN ret;
END;
EXPORT DUPE_LIST(lst)
BEGIN
	LOCAL stop_at := GET_LIST_SIZE(lst);
	LOCAL i := 1;
	LOCAL ret := {};
	FOR i FROM 1 TO stop_at DOf
		ret[0] := lst[i];
	END;
	RETURN ret;
END;

EXPORT RENDER_PAGE(data, page_idx)
BEGIN
	LOCAL x_offset := 10;
    LOCAL y_offset := 10;
	LOCAL current_page := {};
    LOCAL current_lines := {};
	LOCAL current_line := {};
	LOCAL current_words := {};
    LOCAL current_word := {};
	LOCAL all_lines := {};
	LOCAL all_pages := {};
	LOCAL this_line := {};
	LOCAL max_x := 318 - 10;
    LOCAL max_y := 212 - 10;
    LOCAL wordspace_size := 5;
    LOCAL letterspace_size := 2;
    LOCAL line_height := 14;
	LOCAL current_idx := 1;
	LOCAL STOP_AT := GET_MATRIX_TALLY(data);
	LOCAL cnt := 1;
	LOCAL cnt2 := 1;
	LOCAL curr_cnt := 0;
	LOCAL subtract_num := 0;
	LOCAL size1 := 1;
	LOCAL these_words := {};
	LOCAL these_lines := {};
	LOCAL new_words := {};
	LOCAL this_width := 1;
	LOCAL stop_work1 := FALSE;
	LOCAL stop_work2 := FALSE;
	LOCAL root_idx := 1;
	LOCAL d := 65;
	LOCAL this_letterspace_size := 1;
	LOCAL new_x := 1;
	
	WHILE root_idx <= STOP_AT DO
		d := data[root_idx];
		root_idx := root_idx - (subtract_num);
		subtract_num := 0;
		
		stop_work1 := FALSE;
		
		IF d == 32 THEN
			x_offset := x_offset += wordspace_size; 
			current_words[0] := current_word;
			current_word := {};
			stop_work1 := TRUE;
		END;
		IF stop_work1 <> TRUE THEN			
			IF d <> -1 THEN						
				stop_work2 := FALSE;			
				this_width := ZZZ_GET_CHAR_WIDTH(d);
				this_letterspace_size := letterspace_size + 0;
				new_x := x_offset + this_width;

				IF (new_x <= max_x) THEN
					current_word[0] := d;
					x_offset := x_offset + this_width + this_letterspace_size;
					stop_work2 := TRUE;
				END;					
				
				IF ((y_offset + line_height <= max_y) AND stop_work2 <> TRUE) THEN															
					these_words := DUPE_LIST(current_words);
					curr_cnt := GET_LIST_SIZE(these_words);					
					current_word := {};
					current_words := {};
					all_lines[0] := DUPE_LIST(these_words);
					y_offset := y_offset + line_height;
					x_offset := 10;
					subtract_num := (curr_cnt + 1);
					continue;
				END;
			END;
		END;
	END;
	
	
END;
